## Describe the bug
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## Steps to reproduce
1. Go to '...' (Purchase List, Price List or Master Data)
2. Enter / click / print '...'
3. See error

## Expected behavior
What you expected to happen.

## Screenshots
If applicable, add screenshots or a photo of the printed sheet. Please blur or replace any real client names, quantities or prices.

## Environment
- Device / OS: [e.g. Android 13, Windows 11]
- How it is opened: [e.g. Chrome, installed from Add to Home screen, MobileGallery-v4.apk, index.html from file]
- Build id (from `/version.json` on the hosted site, if known): [e.g. 20260915-0600-abc1234]

## Additional context
Any other context (browser console output, printer model, etc.). Do not attach real backup files.
